title: Bounds on encoded component lengths
statement: For all bit strings $\alpha,x$ and all natural numbers $n,t$, each of $|\alpha|$, $|x|$, $n$, and $t$ is at most the length of the nested encoding $\langle\alpha,\langle x,\langle 1^n,1^t\rangle\rangle\rangle$, where $1^j$ denotes the word of $j$ ones.
replaced: For all bit strings $\alpha, x$ and all $n, t \in \mathbb{N}$, each of $|\alpha|$, $|x|$, $n$ and $t$ is at most the length of the quadruple encoding $\langle\alpha,\langle x,\langle 1^n,1^t\rangle\rangle\rangle$, where $\langle a,b\rangle$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding and $1^k$ is the word of $k$ ones.
